reuse.why: Expresses the rule through recurConfigToRSchedule's existing byDayOfWeek option, the one function every path (getNextDate via parseRecurDate, getUpcomingDates, find-schedules) already uses to build occurrences.

duplication.why: A three-line change in one place; no logic is repeated at any call site.

placement.why: Recurrence generation lives in shared/schedules.ts recurConfigToRSchedule, exactly where the per-frequency rules are already defined.

scope.why: Only the recurrence builder, a test block and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Very easy to own; the existing weekend-move calls downstream become no-ops for daily schedules, which a reader has to realise, and the test block sits oddly between beforeEach and afterEach.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Works through the existing recurrence builder rather than around it.

one_place.where: recurConfigToRSchedule in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts (daily case adds byDayOfWeek MO-FR when skipWeekend), used by rule-utils parseRecurDate, schedules/app.ts and find-schedules.ts.
